title: 第八章 烈焰与藤蔓的较量第七章 镜中少女的倒影
lines: 第八章：烈焰与藤蔓的较量
午后的阳光透过幻境学院训练场的穹顶琉璃，在地面投下斑驳的光斑。空气中浮动着不同属性魔法元素的气息——东侧的水元素区水汽氤氲，西侧的土元素区尘埃微扬，而中央的试炼台上，两股截然不同的力量正蓄势待发。
“下一组，魔法国凯，对战灵都国苏璃。”
导师洛兰的声音刚落，试炼台两侧便传来不同方向的动静。凯握着嵌有火纹的手环，大步踏上台时，金属靴底与石面碰撞出沉闷的声响。他赤着小臂，古铜色的皮肤上隐约有火焰纹路在流转，那是魔法国“炎脉”家族的标志性印记，只是此刻尚未完全觉醒。
“灵都国的贵族小姐，”凯扯了扯嘴角，语气带着几分刻意的散漫，“等会儿别哭着找导师叫停。”
对面的苏璃轻轻提起裙摆，踏上试炼台的动作优雅得像在花园散步。她穿着灵都国特有的淡绿色长袍，袖口绣着藤蔓花纹，手中握着一根缠着常春藤的木杖。听到凯的话，她只是弯了弯眼，眼底却没什么笑意：“魔法国的战士，火焰烧得太旺，可是会引火烧身的。”
周围观赛的学子们窃窃私语起来。
“听说了吗？凯是‘炎脉’家族这代唯一的继承人，可惜三年前家族出事后，他就很少用全力了。”
“苏璃更厉害吧？灵都国皇室旁支，据说能让枯萎的藤蔓开花，治愈力顶尖，操控植物的本事也不差。”
“火克木啊，这局凯不是稳赢？”
“不好说，灵都国的植物魔法最擅长缠缚，说不定能困住火焰呢……”
洛兰导师抬手示意安静，淡蓝色的魔法屏障在试炼台边缘升起，隔绝了外界的干扰：“规则不变，点到为止，一方失去战斗能力或主动认输即为结束。”她顿了顿，目光扫过两人，“记住，魔法的胜负从不止于属性克制。开始。”
“开始”二字落下的瞬间，凯率先动了。
他猛地攥紧手环，口中低喝一声：“燃！”手环上的火纹骤然亮起橙红色光芒，一股灼热的气浪以他为中心扩散开来，试炼台边缘的温度瞬间升高。两道尺长的火焰从他掌心窜出，如同活过来的火蛇，带着噼啪的声响，直扑苏璃面门。
速度极快，带着不容置疑的侵略性。
苏璃却站在原地没动，直到火焰即将触及她的袍角时，她才轻抬木杖，低声念诵起灵都国的古老咒文。她的声音清浅，却仿佛带着某种与自然共鸣的韵律，话音未落，试炼台地面突然裂开数道细缝，翠绿的藤蔓如同听到召唤的蛇群，猛地窜出地面，瞬间交织成一张密不透风的藤网。
火焰撞上藤网，发出刺耳的灼烧声，腾起一阵灰白色的烟雾。藤蔓被火焰燎得焦黑卷曲，却没有立刻断裂，反而借着烟雾的掩护，像有生命般顺着火焰袭来的方向蜿蜒，悄无声息地缠向凯的脚踝。
“雕虫小技。”凯冷哼一声，脚尖在地面重重一跺。
一圈环形火焰以他的脚为中心炸开，灼热的气浪瞬间将缠来的藤蔓烧成灰烬，连带着地面都被烤得泛起焦黑。他身形一晃，如同离弦之箭般冲向苏璃，掌心的火焰凝聚成一柄半透明的火刃，刃尖闪烁着刺目的红光。
苏璃眼神微凝，木杖在地面轻点。这次，不再是纤细的藤蔓，而是数根水桶粗的巨藤破土而出，表面覆盖着坚硬的木刺，如同竖起的城墙，挡在她身前。同时，更多的细藤从巨藤的缝隙中钻出，如同灵活的鞭子，抽向凯的侧腰。
凯挥动火刃，迎着巨藤斩去。火刃与巨藤碰撞的瞬间，爆发出刺眼的光芒，巨藤表面被烧出一道焦痕，却只是微微一震，并未断裂。而那些抽来的细藤则被他周身的火焰逼退，在空中烧成火星。
“你的火焰，就这点温度？”苏璃的声音透过藤墙传来，带着一丝清冷，“炎脉家族的传人，也不过如此。”
这句话像是刺痛了凯。他猛地仰头，发出一声类似野兽的低吼，手臂上的火焰纹路骤然变得清晰，颜色从橙红转为炽白。他周身的火焰瞬间暴涨，连带着那柄火刃都变得凝实了几分，边缘甚至泛起了蓝色的焰光——那是火焰魔法即将突破境界的征兆。
“别逼我！”他的声音带着压抑的怒火，“灵都国的温室花朵，根本不懂火焰的力量！”
他再次挥动火刃，这一次，火焰中仿佛夹杂着某种咆哮的力量，斩在巨藤上时，竟直接将那坚硬的藤蔓从中劈开，焦黑的断口处冒着白烟。藤墙出现了一道缺口，苏璃的身影在缺口后隐约可见。
凯正要趁势突进，脚下却突然一紧。
低头看去，数根暗绿色的藤蔓不知何时缠上了他的小腿，这些藤蔓表面覆盖着一层粘稠的汁液，接触到他的火焰时并未燃烧，反而发出“滋滋”的声响，像是在吸收热量。
“这是……噬火藤？”凯皱眉。灵都国的植物魔法果然诡异，连专门克制火焰的植物都能召唤。
就在他分神的瞬间，苏璃动了。她没有趁机攻击，反而双手握住木杖，闭上眼睛，口中的咒文变得急促而低沉。随着她的吟唱，试炼台上的藤蔓开始疯狂生长，不仅填补了藤墙的缺口，更从四面八方涌来，如同潮水般包裹向凯，甚至有几根藤蔓绕过他的防御，缠向了他握着手环的手腕。
“想捆住我？”凯眼中闪过一丝狠厉，全身的火焰猛地爆发，形成一个巨大的火球，将他整个人包裹其中。噬火藤一接触到这团火焰，立刻发出凄厉的灼烧声，迅速枯萎。
但苏璃似乎早有预料，她猛地睁开眼，木杖指向天空：“缚！”
那些被火焰逼退的藤蔓突然改变方向，不再直接接触火焰，而是在空中交织缠绕，形成一个巨大的藤笼，将火球困在中央。藤笼的缝隙越来越小，不断挤压着火球的范围，同时，藤笼表面渗出细密的水珠——那是苏璃用植物魔法凝聚的水汽，虽然微弱，却能一点点削弱火焰的强度。
content_en:
Chapter 8: The battle between flames and vines
The afternoon sun shines through the glass dome of the Fantasy Academy training ground, casting mottled light spots on the ground. There are scents of magic elements with different properties floating in the air - the water element area on the east side is full of water vapor, the earth element area on the west side is slightly dusty, and on the trial platform in the center, two completely different forces are gaining momentum.
"The next group, Magic Kingdom Kai, versus Lingdu Kingdom Su Li."
As soon as the instructor Luo Lan's voice fell, there were movements from different directions on both sides of the trial platform. Holding a bracelet embedded with fire patterns, Kai strode onto the stage, making a dull sound as the soles of his metal boots collided with the stone surface. His forearms were bare, and there were faint flame patterns flowing on his bronze skin. They were the iconic marks of the "Fire Vein" family in the Magic Kingdom, but they were not yet fully awakened at this moment.
"Young lady from Lingdu Kingdom," Kai twitched his lips, his tone deliberately casual, "Don't cry to your instructor later to stop."
Su Li, who was opposite, gently lifted up her skirt and stepped onto the trial stage as elegantly as if she were walking in a garden. She was wearing a light green robe unique to Lingdu Kingdom, with arabesques embroidered on the cuffs, and she was holding a wooden staff wrapped with ivy in her hand. Hearing Kai's words, she just rolled her eyes, but there was no smile in her eyes: "Soldiers of the Magic Kingdom, if the flames are too strong, they will burn themselves."
The students watching the game began to whisper.
"Have you heard? Kai is the only heir of this generation of the Yanmai family. Unfortunately, after the family incident three years ago, he rarely used his full strength."
"Isn't Su Li more powerful? A branch of the royal family of Lingdu Kingdom. It is said that he can make withered vines bloom. He has top-notch healing power and is also good at controlling plants."
"Huo Kemu, isn't Kai a sure winner in this game?"
"It's hard to say. The plant magic in Lingdu Kingdom is best at binding. Maybe it can trap flames..."
Instructor Luo Lan raised her hand to signal for silence, and a light blue magic barrier rose on the edge of the trial platform, blocking out external interference: "The rules remain unchanged, until the point is reached, it will end when one party loses the ability to fight or voluntarily admits defeat." She paused and glanced at the two of them, "Remember, the victory or defeat of magic never stops at attribute restraint. Start."
The moment the word "start" fell, Kai took action.
He clenched the bracelet tightly and shouted in a low voice: "Burn!" The fire pattern on the bracelet suddenly lit up with an orange-red light, and a scorching wave of air spread around him, and the temperature at the edge of the trial platform increased instantly. Two feet long flames shot out from his palm, like a fire snake coming to life, with a crackling sound, and rushed towards Su Li's face.
Extremely fast and undeniably aggressive.
Su Li stood still, until the flames were about to touch the corner of her robe, then she gently raised the wooden staff and recited the ancient incantation of the Lingdu Kingdom in a low voice. Her voice was clear and shallow, but it seemed to have some kind of rhythm that resonated with nature. Before she finished her words, the ground of the trial platform suddenly opened several small cracks. The green vines, like a group of snakes that heard the summons, suddenly sprang out of the ground and instantly intertwined into an airtight vine network.
"Tsk——"
The flames hit the vine net, making a harsh burning sound and sending up a burst of gray-white smoke. The vines were scorched black and curled by the flames, but they did not break immediately. Instead, under the cover of the smoke, they snaked along the direction of the flames like they were alive, and silently wrapped around Kai's ankles.
"It's a little trick." Kai snorted coldly and stomped his toes on the ground.
"Boom!"
A circle of ring-shaped flames exploded with his feet as the center, and the scorching hot air waves instantly burned the entangled vines to ashes, and even the ground was scorched black. He swayed and rushed towards Su Li like an arrow from a string. The flames in his palm condensed into a translucent fire blade, and the tip of the blade flashed with a dazzling red light.
Su Li's eyes narrowed slightly and she tapped her wooden stick on the ground. This time, instead of slender vines, several giant vines as thick as buckets sprouted out of the ground, covered with hard wooden thorns, like a city wall erected in front of her. At the same time, more thin vines emerged from the gaps in the giant vines, like flexible whips, whipping towards Kai's side.
"Broken!"
Kai swung the fire blade and slashed at the giant vine. The moment the fire blade collided with the giant vine, a dazzling light erupted. A scorch mark was burned on the surface of the giant vine, but it only shook slightly and did not break. The thin vines that were pulled out were forced back by the flames around him, burning into sparks in the air.
"Is your flame just this warm?" Su Li's voice came through the vine wall, with a hint of coldness, "The descendant of the Yanmai family is no more than this."
This sentence seemed to sting Kai. He raised his head suddenly and let out a low roar like a beast. The flame patterns on his arms suddenly became clear, and the color changed from orange-red to blazing white. The flames around him surged instantly, and even the fire blade became a little more solid, and there was even a blue flame on the edge - that was a sign that the flame magic was about to break through.
"Don't force me!" His voice was filled with suppressed anger, "The greenhouse flowers of Lingdu Kingdom don't understand the power of fire at all!"
He waved the fire blade again, and this time, the flames seemed to be mixed with some kind of roaring power. When he slashed at the giant vine, it split the hard vine directly, and white smoke came out from the charred fracture. A gap appeared in the vine wall, and Su Li's figure was vaguely visible behind the gap.
Kai was about to take advantage of the situation and rush in, but his feet suddenly tightened.
Looking down, he saw that several dark green vines had wrapped around his calf at some point. The surface of these vines was covered with a layer of sticky juice. They did not burn when they came into contact with his flames. Instead, they made a "sizzling" sound, as if they were absorbing heat.
"Is this... Fire-Eating Vine?" Kai frowned. The plant magic in Lingdu Kingdom is really weird, even plants that are specialized in suppressing flames can be summoned.
Just when he was distracted, Su Li moved. She did not take the opportunity to attack. Instead, she held the wooden staff with both hands, closed her eyes, and the incantations in her mouth became rapid and low. As she chanted, the vines on the trial platform began to grow crazily, not only filling the gaps in the vine wall, but also coming from all directions, wrapping around Xiang Kai like a tide. Some vines even bypassed his defense and wrapped around his wrist holding the bracelet.
"You want to tie me up?" A fierce look flashed in Kai's eyes, and the flames all over his body suddenly burst out, forming a huge fireball that enveloped his entire body. As soon as the fire-eating vine came into contact with the flame, it immediately made a shrill burning sound and quickly withered.
But Su Li seemed to have expected it. She opened her eyes suddenly and pointed the wooden staff at the sky: "Bind!"
The vines forced back by the flames suddenly changed direction and no longer directly contacted the flames. Instead, they intertwined in the air and formed a huge vine cage, trapping the fireball in the center. The gaps in the vine cage are getting smaller and smaller, constantly squeezing the scope of the fireball. At the same time, fine water droplets seep out from the surface of the vine cage - that is the water vapor condensed by Su Li using plant magic. Although it is weak, it can gradually weaken the intensity of the flame.
